verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Spend AI pages say it applies your spend rules automatically and catches issues early so approvers review only exceptions. Cards also support custom spend limits. However, there is no documentation of how policy rules are authored, whether limits can vary by category, role, or context, or that in-policy expenses are auto-approved outright. Missing for 10: documented rule configuration by category/role/context, explicit auto-approval of in-policy expenses, exception-routing configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can codify our expense policy — limits by category, role, and context — so in-policy expenses auto-approve and only exceptions reach a human

citations.quote: Always-on checks to audit reports and apply your spend rules automatically, without slowing employees down.
Duplicates and other common issues are caught early, so approvers focus only on what truly needs review.
Missing, unclear, or invalid receipts are flagged before they reach approval, reducing rework later.
Issue multi-currency corporate cards with custom spend limits
You always stay in control, with clear visibility into AI-driven actions and the ability to review, adjust, or override them.
